item.title: About
item.description:
Hello there! I am currently an SWE @ Agrani Labs. I graduated from IIT Bombay in 2025.

On the technical side, I am deeply passionate towards the areas of architecture, distributed systems, compilers and LLM training & inference. In general, anything technical deeply intrigues me and usually I am not satisfied till I understand
it to its fundamental concepts.

I am currently working on/exploring compilation for heterogenous hardware.

Previously, I have had experience in Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval through my coursework. You can visit the “Projects” page to know more.
